sv.title: Xis krigsgliring till Trump och Putin: ”Förväntas mer”
sv.summary: SHENZHEN/HONGKONG. Under det historiska mötet mellan Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin och Xi Jinping i den sydkinesiska staden Shenzhen talades det ökad oljeproduktion och nedrustning – men utan konkreta besked.

en.title: Xi's saber-rattling toward Trump and Putin: “Expected to do more”
en.summary: SHENZHEN/HONGKONG. During the historic meeting between Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen, increased oil production and disarmament were discussed, but without concrete commitments.
